eid_r.declaration: Loreley computes its own identity: evaluator_name = WORKER_EVALUATOR_PLUGIN (evaluator.py:1481-1485), evaluator_version = source fingerprint of that module (evaluator_identity.py:90-105), campaign_program_hash = sha256 of loreley.program.md (campaign_program.py:212). The adapter renders loreley.program.md from the frozen EID* document (Goal / Primary metric / Correctness gates / Evaluation budget sections come from EID*.Config and EID*.MetricDefinition), so the triple is a function of EID*; eidr_derivation is the sha256 over (eid_star, plugin_source_sha256, campaign_program_sha256, native_scheme) and recomputes.
